articles.summary: Rusty orange oxide scales with turquoise verdigris patches and surviving ruby-red enamel flakes; semi-matte, rough, sparkly. A heavily weathered orange, red and turquoise patchwork; orange rust dominates, red enamel and teal corrosion break it up, as photographic as a scrapyard panel.
